name: WamekEA MoveStopLoss
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that moves the stop loss of existing positions as price moves in favor. It offers two modes: an ATR-based dynamic trail using 85% of the 30-bar max ATR, or a fixed-distance trail set by the user.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个移动止损工具，随着价格朝有利方向移动而调整已有持仓的止损位。提供两种模式：基于ATR的动态追踪（使用30根K线最大ATR的85%），或用户设定的固定距离追踪。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不主动开仓，仅对已有持仓进行止损管理。追踪止损的核心逻辑是：对于多头仓位，当当前买价高于开仓价且当前止损低于买价减去追踪距离时，将止损上移至买价减去追踪距离；对于空头仓位，当当前卖价低于开仓价且当前止损高于卖价加上追踪距离（或止损为零）时，将止损下移至卖价加上追踪距离。追踪距离由两种方式决定：若AutoTrail为true，则使用0.85乘以近30根K线ATR的最大值；若为false，则使用固定点数Distance2Trail。ATR计算采用7周期ATR指标，遍历近30根K线取最大值和最小值，但仅使用最大值作为追踪基准。仓位管理方面仅修改止损，不涉及加仓或减仓。资金管理完全缺失，没有账户权益或风险比例的考量。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not open trades autonomously; it only manages the stop loss of existing positions. The trailing stop logic works as follows: for buy positions, when the current bid is above the open price and the current stop loss is below bid minus the trail distance, the stop loss is moved up to bid minus trail distance. For sell positions, when the current ask is below the open price and the current stop loss is above ask plus trail distance (or is zero), the stop loss is moved down to ask plus trail distance. The trail distance is determined in two ways: if AutoTrail is true, it uses 0.85 times the maximum ATR value over the last 30 bars; if false, it uses the fixed pip distance specified by Distance2Trail. The ATR calculation uses a 7-period ATR indicator, iterating over 30 bars to find the maximum and minimum, though only the maximum is used for trailing. Position sizing is not applicable as the EA never opens positions. Money management is entirely absent with no consideration of account equity or risk ratios.

parameters.name: AutoTrail
parameters.description: 是否使用ATR动态追踪止损，true为ATR模式，false为固定距离模式
parameters.description_en: ATR trailing stop mode; false=fixed distance

parameters.name: Distance2Trail
parameters.description: 固定追踪距离（点数），仅在AutoTrail为false时生效
parameters.description_en: Fixed trail distance in points, used when AutoTrail=false

pros: 提供ATR动态追踪和固定距离两种模式，灵活性较好
ATR模式使用30根K线最大值作为基准，能适应波动率变化，避免止损过近
对空头仓位处理了止损为零的特殊情况，防止未设止损的仓位被遗漏
pros_en: Offers both ATR-based dynamic trailing and fixed-distance trailing modes, providing good flexibility
ATR mode uses the 30-bar maximum as the basis, adapting to volatility changes and preventing stops that are too tight
Handles the zero stop loss edge case for sell positions, ensuring positions without stops are not overlooked
cons: ATR计算效率低下，每tick都重新遍历30根K线调用CopyBuffer，应缓存或仅在新K线时更新
0.85的ATR乘数硬编码，用户无法调整此关键参数，缺乏适应性
没有止损修改失败的处理逻辑，trade.PositionModify的返回值未被检查
仅在价格超过开仓价后才开始追踪，无法在浮盈较小时保护利润
AtrMin变量被计算但从未使用，属于无效代码
cons_en: ATR calculation is inefficient, iterating over 30 bars and calling CopyBuffer every tick instead of caching or updating only on new bars
The 0.85 ATR multiplier is hardcoded and cannot be adjusted by the user, reducing adaptability
No error handling for stop loss modification failures; the return value of trade.PositionModify is not checked
Trailing only activates after price exceeds the open price, failing to protect small unrealized profits
AtrMin variable is calculated but never used, representing dead code
improvements: 将ATR乘数（0.85）和ATR回溯周期（30）设为可调输入参数，增加灵活性
仅在新生成K线时更新ATR值而非每tick计算，大幅提升性能；同时检查PositionModify的返回值并记录错误日志
增加最小盈利距离参数，允许在未超过开仓价时也启动追踪；增加止损修改的最小步进检查，避免过于频繁修改止损
improvements_en: Make the ATR multiplier (0.85) and ATR lookback period (30) adjustable input parameters for greater flexibility
Update ATR values only on new bar formation instead of every tick for significant performance improvement; also check PositionModify return values and log errors
Add a minimum profit distance parameter to allow trailing before price exceeds the open price; add a minimum step check to avoid excessively frequent stop loss modifications

risk_points: PositionModify失败时无错误处理，可能导致止损未按预期移动而用户不知情
每tick重复计算ATR并修改止损，在高波动行情下可能因频繁请求触发服务器限制
risk_points_en: No error handling when PositionModify fails, which could leave the stop loss unmoved without the user being aware
Recalculating ATR and attempting stop loss modifications every tick may trigger server rate limits during high volatility
